text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Private sector employees call for pay rises as the world celebrates Labour Day on Thursday.
- Bahrain aims to increase its conference and exhibition facilities by around 75 percent over the next two to three years, official says.
- Aluminium Bahrain starts an 8.9 million dinar project for environmentally friendly aluminium production.
- Some three million shares worth more than 687,000 dinars changed hands on the Bahrain Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
- Gulf Internationl Bank mandates Chase Manhattan to manage $200 million floating rate note issue on the international market.
